headline: Mohamed Belloumi grabs point for Hull in seesaw draw with Everton
body: Hull retained their unbeaten home record since returning to the Premier League with an entertaining draw against Everton at the MKM Stadium. Brennan Johnson found the net in the 34th minute but was denied a first Premier League goal for Everton following a video assistant referee check, leaving the sides to go in goalless at the break. The hosts wasted little time after the interval, however, as Joe Gelhardt opened the scoring in the 48th minute following an error by Ainsley Maitland-Niles. Continue reading...
